subject.title: Feature: Inject post-install/update system event into active session

question: Should ClawHub replace the current no-direct-handoff boundary with an authenticated active-session notification, and which setup actions must require explicit user approval?
rationale: The setup-reliability goal is supported, but the proposed behavior routes third-party package instructions into trusted session execution and reverses an approved product boundary; implementation cannot safely choose that contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Consent-gated runtime handoff
options.body: Send bounded install/update metadata to OpenClaw and require explicit approval before commands, configuration changes, plugin activation, health fixes, or restarts.

options.title: Improve explicit setup prompts
options.body: Keep ClawHub and active sessions separated while making install and update completion guidance consistently visible, inspectable, and copyable.

options.title: Automatic onboarding execution
options.body: Inject a system directive that immediately reads and executes installed skill instructions in the selected active session.

recommendation.title: Consent-gated runtime handoff
recommendation.body: Send bounded install/update metadata to OpenClaw and require explicit approval before commands, configuration changes, plugin activation, health fixes, or restarts.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the relevant current-main paths and explicitly sponsored the direction in the issue discussion.
